- **25 November:** Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 October. I asked her there where it came from, and she hasn't replied yet. I found no amendment that changes the date, though the knowledge search was keyword-only, so I can't rule one out.

My first reply to Marcus said Ilse posted on Monday. It was Wednesday 14 October, and I corrected that in a second message in the same thread.

Marcus is in #north-team, so everything I told him is something he can already see. The reply has no prices or other money terms.
